# Rotate

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Rotates a native subtree clockwise without rasterising its content.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IContentContainer`, `IStatefulElement`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new Rotate()
```

## Properties

- [`Angle`](#angle): Finite clockwise degrees.
- [`Child`](#child): The subtree to rotate.
- [`ContentWidth`](#contentwidth): Optional positive width of the child before rotation, in points.
- [`Mode`](#mode): Free angles or constrained multiples of 90 degrees.
